content.summary: The strongest abstract and conclusion claims remain within the checked interfaces. External vacuity is acknowledged without being used to establish the local support result. Both frozen hashes match; no integrated scope revision is required.

checks.scope: Actual support, universe quantification, and exclusion boundaries
checks.method: Compared the abstract, prior-work qualification, and conclusion with LiteralStatements, SupportFinish53, and SupportReduction.
checks.observation: The assembled theorem concludes actual union cardinality <=53 for Type u under the advertised family hypotheses, without assuming I(27). The equivalence uses the named Type-level I(27), while separate counterexample reductions cover arbitrary universes. Neither direction establishes finite nonexistence. Importing the external I(27) result would make the 28-member class empty, as the manuscript states; this limits extremal significance but does not invalidate an independently assembled conditional support theorem. No existence, sharpness, exclusion, or new extremal-value claim is made.
